title: Moroccan Mulukhiyah Tagine
description: A traditional Moroccan stew made with mulukhiyah and a blend of spices, slow-cooked in a clay pot. This hearty and flavorful dish is perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large clay pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the mulukhiyah, spice blend, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the tagine and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
